[[File:Chicken icon.png|left]]
'''Chickens''' are a type of bird kept as livestock by [[farmer]]s and are often found inside pens in the [[farm]]s of [[Gielinor]]. Chickens are one of the weakest enemies in ''RuneScape'', but are very beneficial for low-level players to kill as they have very low [[Defence]] and deal hardly any damage. Any damage taken whilst killing them could be easily mitigated by cooking the [[raw chicken]] they are guaranteed to drop on kill. Chickens, like most birds, count for [[Birds (Slayer assignment)|birds Slayer assignment]], which are given by the Slayer Masters [[Turael]] and [[Spria]].

Chickens are the primary source of several useful [[item]]s, such as [[egg]]s for [[Cooking]] and [[Summoning]], [[bones]] for [[Prayer]], [[feathers]] for [[Fishing]] or [[Fletching]]. Because of this, killing chickens can be very profitable for low-level players.

Rarely, a chicken will respawn by falling from the sky and saying, "I have returned". This variant drops the [[off-hand rubber chicken]], which is needed to complete the [[Slayer collection log]].

They occasionally lay [[egg]]s on the ground.

==Trivia==
* At [[RuneFest 2011]], chickens were spawned at the [[Grand Exchange]] by a [[Jagex moderator]] demonstrating how the [[rotten potato]] works.
* A chicken could be found in the basement of the [[Wizards' Tower]] before the area received a graphical update on [[28 November]] [[2012]].
